talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.npc: You're back! I just had an interesting chat with a group of lesser gods. Seems you dealt a heavy blow to the Devourer and made some powerful new friends in the process.

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.player: It didn't go perfectly. Amascut still escaped, and she'd already gained a fair amount of power by that point.

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.npc: True, but things could have wound up going a lot worse. You're right though, this is clearly far from over.

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.player: Where do you think she'll have gone? Menaphos?

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.npc: Most likely. She didn't go to all the effort of causing those plagues for nothing. This tomb was clearly only part of her plan.
Still, she'll need to reconsider her strategy after her defeat. We have a little time now.

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.player: Hopefully time for the city to reopen again. What will you do in the meantime?

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.npc: The lesser gods were under the Devourer's control for a long time, and a lot's changed since they disappeared. I've offered to help them where I can.

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.player: Then I guess this is goodbye for now.

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.npc: Indeed, but before I go, I have something for you.

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.text: Maisa gives you an antique lamp.

talking-to-maisa-after-completing-the-ra.npc: Don't mention it. Now, take care of yourself out there.
